}}

{{recipe}} 

This is great served with grilled steak, roast chicken, or vegetable sauté.

== Ingredients ==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] (450 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) each Russet [[Cookbook:Potato|potatoes]] and redskin potatoes, cut into 2-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] (5 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]]) cubes
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] salt
* 1 tbsp freshly ground [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* 1 ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] each dried [[Cookbook:Parsley|parsley]], [[Cookbook:Rosemary|rosemary]], [[Cookbook:Thyme|thyme]], [[Cookbook:Basil|basil]] and [[Cookbook:Oregano|oregano]]

== Procedure ==
#Heat a large pot of water to a boil. Add potatoes and cook for 10 minutes. Shock in a bowl of ice water.
#Drain and refrigerate for 1 hour.
#Combine remaining ingredients. Add potatoes and [[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|toss]] to coat.
#Spread out in one even layer on your largest [[Cookbook:Baking Pan|baking pan]]. Roast at 450°F (230°C) for 20 minutes, stirring halfway. 
#Serve warm.
